company.name: Oxygen
company.shortDescription: Financial platform for the 21st century - providing digital natives, creators & entrepreneurs consumer & business banking in a single app.
company.description:
Oxygen is a modern financial platform designed for the 21st century economy - providing digital natives, creators and entrepreneurs pushing everyday boundaries a banking partner that understands how they live and work, offering a seamless user experience for both personal & business accounts in a single application. 

Available on iOS and Android, Oxygen users enjoy no monthly fees, early direct deposit, simple transfers, Cashback rewards, High Yield Savings, subscription reimbursements and everyday retail and travel benefits. Businesses can easily control their finances with solutions that are elegant, simple, and secure.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series B round raised $20,000,000, or 44.44% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $29,070,308 to $161,967,926, a 5.57x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
